thread:
maria: Heads up — I noticed our private VPC nightly bench is showing ~12% higher p99 on the on-prem nodes after the kernel bump. Can someone run a quick parity run vs hosted for the new image?
kevin: on it. which image tag + config?
sasha: flagged earlier, might be C-state or power cap related. also could be NIC offload differences.
maria: tag: rwinf/runtime:2026-03-10-km. Config same as last parity: 4xA100, seq_len=2048, batch=8, async batching enabled. Use the vpc subnet test harness (vpc-bench.sh) and capture dstat + perf on the run.
kevin: running now on rack-12 node3 (ip 10.2.12.33). starting with a smoke step then full run.
infra-bot: deploy-triggered: vpc-bench.sh --image rwinf/runtime:2026-03-10-km --nodes rack-12-node3 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --async true
kevin: smoke looks clean, latency baseline ~23ms median, p99 ~210ms. Will kick off full 1hr bench and attach logs.
maria: thanks. please also grab /proc/cmdline and tuned profile (we had tunables changed across racks).
kevin: pasted output: `BOOT_IMAGE=/vmlinuz root=/dev/nvme0n1p3 ro quiet splash intel_pstate=active`
sasha: can you check msr-tools diff for turbo ratio and show `tuned-adm active`?
kevin: tuned-adm active -> "throughput-performance". msr dump looks same as last parity run.
eli: small ask — when you upload the run, please include: 1) perf top sampled flame for token loop, 2) `nstat` network counters, 3) `ethtool -k` for the NIC.
kevin: attaching: logs/1809456789-full-run.log, perf/flame.svg, dstat.csv, ethtool.txt, nstat.out
kevin: quick summary: CPU steal ~0.1%, irq distribution skewed to core 0, net drops 0, CPU cycles vs ref lower on node3 by ~8% at hotspots in attention kernel.
sasha: interesting. attention kernel regresses could point to kernel ABI/GLIBC change affecting vectorized codepaths. Did you run with the same libvkernel build?
kevin: libvkernel = v1.3.2 on node3; hosted uses v1.3.2 too. binary checksums match.
maria: can you rerun with `KMP_AFFINITY=granularity=fine,compact,1` and IRQ pinning to cores 2-7? Put results in a separate log.
kevin: re-run queued with affinity + isolcpus=2-7 on kernel cmdline. ETA ~20m.
aria: @kevin remember to toggle RDT lockback test too (we saw interference before).
kevin: noted. RDT test toggled.
kevin: re-run done. Median ~22ms, p99 ~195ms, attention hotspots normalized to within 2% of hosted. Looks like IRQ/core layout + affinity fixed it.
maria: great — can you capture the exact kernel cmdline and doc the change so eng-infra can roll it to other racks?
kevin: kernel cmdline now: `BOOT_IMAGE=/vmlinuz root=/dev/nvme0n1p3 ro quiet splash intel_pstate=active isolcpus=2-7`
sasha: can we add a quick script to apply irqbalance mask and set `KMP_AFFINITY` in the runtime service unit? I can send a PR.
maria: please do. Also add a short note to the private-deploy runbook about this parity check and the mitigation steps.
eli: I'll draft the runbook blurb and link the logs.
kevin: PR: github.com/rwinf/infra/commit/ab12cd34 - adds irq pinning + env var.
maria: thanks all. follow-up: schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to decide if we keep isolcpus or try a tuned irqbalance config.
kevin: +1 for sync.
sasha: +1.
infra-bot: calendar-event created: "VPC parity followup" tomorrow 10:30am (invites: maria, kevin, sasha, eli) :calendar:
